field_evidence.resource_name: Shut in lifts incidents attended by LFB in last 36 months

records.evidence_slice: London Datastore publishes the London Fire Brigade 'Shut in lift releases (lift entrapments) attended by LFB' dataset. The current listed resource covers August 2023 through July 2026, is updated monthly, and supplies incident location fields including postcode, borough and ward. This batch binds the verified Campden ward identity to that unused 36-month public-safety source window without claiming an extracted Campden incident row, geometry, parcel join or parcel progress.
